Agent registry entries are a discriminated union on `kind`:

**`A2AAgentEntry`** — remote A2A agents reachable over HTTP:

- `kind: "a2a"`
- `name: string`
- `url: string`

**`ACPAgentEntry`** — locally spawnable ACP harnesses:

- `kind: "acp"`
- `name: string`
- `harness: string`
- `command?: string`
- `args?: string[]`
- `env?: Record<string, string>`
- `workspaceFlag?: string`
